description: This file contains PHPUnit test cases for the Goteo blog Post model, including tests for creation, validation, retrieval, editing, image handling, and deletion of blog posts.

classes.name: PostTest
classes.description: Unit test class for testing the functionality of the Goteo Blog Post model, including creation, validation, retrieval, editing, and deletion.

methods.name: setUpBeforeClass
methods.description: Prepares test environment by creating temporary image files and setting static data for tests.

methods.name: testInstance
methods.description: Tests instantiation of the Post model.

methods.name: testValidatePost
methods.description: Verifies validation and save failure with incomplete data.

methods.name: testCreatePost
methods.description: Creates a new post with predefined data and verifies successful validation and saving.

methods.name: testGetPost
methods.description: Tests retrieving a post by ID and verifying its data matches the original data.

methods.name: testSlugPost
methods.description: Verifies the slug functionality and uniqueness, including slug generation and retrieval by slug.

methods.name: testEditPost
methods.description: Tests editing a post, including updating the title and images, and verifies persistence.

methods.name: testRemoveImagePost
methods.description: Tests removal of images from a post, including proper gallery updates and autodeletion.

methods.name: testDeletePost
methods.description: Deletes a post and verifies it no longer exists.

methods.name: testNonExisting
methods.description: Checks retrieval of a non-existent post, expecting failure.

methods.name: testCleanProjectRelated
methods.description: Ensures database tables related to posts are consistent, cleaning up orphaned records.

methods.name: tearDownAfterClass
methods.description: Cleans up temporary image files created during setup.
